common_analysis_rules.inferential_unit: donor; nuclei, tissue pieces and technical replicates are not independent donors
common_analysis_rules.cross_cohort_pooling: prohibited; never pool Jin with GSE329417 or construct a premenopausal comparison
common_analysis_rules.causal_language: All designs are cross-sectional associations. Do not call RNA-chromatin coupling chronological causal coupling.
common_analysis_rules.future_resources: Any later acquisition/analysis requires parent approval and sequential resource-guarded jobs; 30 GB disk reserve and <=8 GB analysis memory. Do not use either series RAW tar by default.

design.histology: Primary paper states all eight had normal ovarian histology; H&E was performed on all eight (3-5 slides/sample).
design.procurement: Fresh-frozen normal ovaries purchased from BioIVT and Cureline; sudden-death or bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy sources; frozen within 16 h post-mortem/post-surgery.
design.assays: Separate 10x Chromium 3prime v3 snRNA and 10x Chromium ATAC v1 snATAC preparations, NextSeq 550, GRCh38. One library of each assay per donor.
design.pairing_conclusion: Donor/tissue matched, not same-nucleus RNA+ATAC multiome. Distinct BioSample accessions and assay-specific extraction protocols confirm separate libraries.

peak_gene_links.paper_method: Cicero co-accessible cis-regulatory networks within 500 kb and ATAC gene activity from gene bodies plus 2 kb upstream; these are inferred links, not experimental causal evidence.
peak_gene_links.requirement: Validate exact peak coordinates/genome build, gene identifiers, link version and cell-type mapping before any donor-matched exploratory linkage.

analysis_plan.primary: Only reproductively_aged-minus-young donor-level contrasts, four versus four. Use each donor once per endpoint; no cell-level p-values and no continuous-age slope.
analysis_plan.eligibility: Before outcomes, validate raw counts and barcode/annotation joins; require >=20 annotated nuclei per donor-cell type and all four donors per group for the small primary contrast, otherwise descriptive only. P1 needs detected up/down genes; Hellinger needs >=50 cross-fitted young-reference nuclei and >=20 passing nuclei per scored donor.
analysis_plan.endpoints: Keep P1, CLR composition, pseudobulk gene expression and Hellinger separate. Report old-minus-young effects with uncertainty and BH within each prespecified endpoint/cell-type family. No outcome has been computed here.
analysis_plan.sensitivity: Check procurement/PMI metadata and technical depth before modeling; do not add unidentifiable covariates to four-versus-four models. The ovary5 47/49 discrepancy does not alter its aged group but must remain explicit and blocks any exact-age use for that donor.
analysis_plan.coupling: No same-nucleus coupling. If valid links are later established, aggregate RNA and linked peak accessibility within donor and harmonized cell type and describe exploratory donor-matched associations only; never chronological causal coupling.

design.assay: 10x Chromium Fixed RNA Profiling/Flex multiplexed snucRNA-seq, 16 unique probe barcodes per plex; Element AVITI; Cell Ranger multi 8.0.0; GRCh38-2024-A.
design.sex_tissue_histology: Women with postmenopausal ovary, cortex and medulla. Ovarian neoplasia and endometriosis excluded; pathologist confirmed no premalignant/malignant ovarian pathology. Non-ovarian benign/premalignant/malignant indications remain and are public covariates.
design.technical_replicate_caveat: Processing samples 3_4 and 16_4 (SN_0086) shared one digested tissue/nuclei isolation aliquot; do not count them as independent biological samples. The log says all other samples used independent tissue chunks/dissociations.
design.mapping_validation: All 64 processing rows matched one unique released H5AD filename, one of four GSMs, one donor and one exact age. Donor tissue-piece counts sum to 64.

raw_counts.status: Public unnormalized but CellBender-corrected UMI count layers, not original uncorrected Cell Ranger raw-count matrices.
raw_counts.per_sample: Each CellBender H5AD has corrected UMI counts in X and layers[raw_counts], restricted to Cell Ranger filtered features/barcodes.
raw_counts.atlas: Final H5AD/SCE raw_counts layer likewise contains CellBender-corrected UMI counts; log1p_norm is separate and must not be used as raw counts.
raw_counts.validation_not_done: No H5AD was downloaded; corrected-count integer/value checks, original-vs-corrected count implications and donor/atlas barcode joins remain future gates.

annotations.immune_object: Separate immune-compartment H5AD includes immune annotations and scVI/UMAP/milo information.
annotations.validation_not_done: Annotation field names, barcode uniqueness and per-donor cell floors were not inspected because expression objects were not downloaded.

analysis_plan.primary: Only within-postmenopausal continuous-exact-age associations, with donor as the inferential unit. No premenopausal comparison and no pooling with Jin.
analysis_plan.repeated_samples: Aggregate to one donor value per endpoint or use sample-level models with donor random effects/donor-clustered uncertainty. Treat SN_0086 samples 3_4 and 16_4 as technical replicates and combine/select them before biological modeling.
analysis_plan.eligibility: Validate exact donor joins, corrected-count integrity and annotation coverage before outcomes. Require >=20 annotated nuclei per donor-cell type and at least 20 eligible donors with residual degrees of freedom for a parsimonious primary model; otherwise report descriptive QC only.
analysis_plan.covariates: Freeze a small identifiable set before outcomes, considering plex/processing batch and prespecified clinical modifiers (BMI, parity and non-ovarian cancer state). Do not fit 64 samples as independent or overfit 28 donors. Parity analyses are secondary and separate from chronological age.
analysis_plan.endpoints: Keep donor-pseudobulk expression, CLR composition and any eligible vector endpoint separate; report age effects per 10 years with 95% intervals and BH within each prespecified endpoint/cell-type family. Corrected-count sensitivity is required because uncorrected Cell Ranger matrices are not separately released.
analysis_plan.fallback: If future count/atlas joins or donor mapping fail, restrict this cohort to descriptive annotation and QC. No association or outcome has been computed here.
